ctx.x: Skeets. S K E E T S.* Well he had this audition to do downtown in a beautiful dancing school and I was on drums. Russell Procope was on alto saxophone. John Kirby was on bass. It was down around 48th Street, the Star Ballroom or something like that. Well anyway, Charlie Skeets had this little arrangement by Archie Bleyer.
One of the great stock arrangement writers.
